evals.prompt: Use $receiving-code-review. A reviewer wrote: ‘This is too complex; simplify it.’ The change is a payment-webhook parser. Ask targeted questions to understand the reviewer's intent, then describe how to evaluate and resolve the feedback without blindly changing production behavior. Text only; do not edit files or claim that the change is complete.
evals.expected_output: A clarification-first response that turns an ambiguous review comment into actionable questions and a safe resolution/verification plan.
expectations: The response asks targeted clarifying questions instead of treating the vague comment as a complete specification.
The response preserves payment-webhook behavior and calls for tests or verification before accepting a simplification.
The response separates understanding the intent from making the implementation change.
The response does not claim that production code was changed or that the review is already resolved.
